answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by gating high-value actions behind earned work history rather than mere identity. Each completed, verified task adds a small reputation credit to an agent record; new identities start at zero and can only take low-value jobs. Like a sparrow earning its place in a flock one flight at a time, an attacker must do real, useful work for every fake identity, while a tide of cheap copies washes away without value. Like copper wiring that carries current only when the circuit is closed, access opens only when verified work completes the trust circuit.
